teaser: A plane ticket bought on a Tuesday afternoon. A hobby abandoned by Friday. You are a 5, the life path called the Adventurer, and an ESFP, the Entertainer — two forces that both run on motion, and neither one likes to sit still long enough to explain why. Most pairings in a catalogue like this have one side pulling toward change and the other toward staying put. Here, both sides want the same door open. That means less resistance and more acceleration: fewer reasons to stop, fewer brakes installed at all. What follows is about a life where nothing in it argues for staying.
excerpt: A museum bench, half of it empty because you have already moved to the next room.
